before.requirement: While reading a valid PNG to IEND, reach supported decompression of compressed ancillary metadata placed after IDAT.
before.reason: png_read_info stops at IDAT and the harness later calls png_read_end. The supplied code does not establish a supported late compressed chunk or the intervening path to its handler.

after.requirement: While reading a valid PNG to IEND, reach the same supported decompression of compressed ancillary metadata placed after IDAT.
after.reason: The decompression routine remains, but the supplied code still does not establish a supported late compressed chunk or whether the harness reaches its handler.

claims.reason: The same old harness calls png_read_update_info, png_start_read_image, png_read_row, and png_read_end on both sides. Without the end-reading path, eligible late handlers, and effective configuration, neither reachability nor a shared concrete blocker can be established.
